summary: Cosan S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing its participation as a selling shareholder in a secondary public offering of common shares of Compass Gás e Energia S.A. in Brazil's unorganized over-the-counter market. Cosan may sell up to approximately 15% of Compass's share capital, including additional and supplementary tranches. The price per share will be determined via bookbuilding. A spin-off of Cosan Dez Participações transferred 20% direct stake in Compass to Cosan. No premium, dates, or advisors are stated. The offering is limited to Brazil, not registered in the U.S. Watch for pricing and regulatory developments.
